info.title: Entity Persistence Platform API
info.description:
This API acts as a central Gateway entry point providing dynamic entity 
management, security, validation, and orchestration services.

parameters.name: set
parameters.description: Advanced filtering with boolean flags, parametric objects (owners/viewers/audience), and dynamic time-bounded sets (e.g., createds-10m, expireds-2w)

additionalProperties.description: Supports dynamic keys following the pattern <base>-<N><unit> (e.g., createds-10m, expireds-2w). Base must be one of: createds, expireds, actives, pendings. Units: m/min (minutes), d/day (days), w (weeks), mo/mon (months).

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Search by name. Translates to a case-insensitive regexp filter on the _name field.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of records to skip (zero-based offset).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Field name to order results by (e.g. _name, _createdDateTime).

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in each record (e.g. _name,id).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated relation names to eagerly include (e.g. category,tags).

parameters.name: lookup
parameters.description: Comma-separated property names to resolve via lookup (e.g. authorId,publisherId).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Invoke a predefined saved query by name. Available values: actives, by-book-name, inactives, my, name, slug. Some queries accept companion parameters (see configuration).

parameters.name: fieldset
parameters.description: Apply a named field projection to the response. In show mode only the listed fields are returned; in hide mode the listed fields are removed. Use fieldsets=false to bypass all fieldset processing.

parameters.name: fieldsets
parameters.description: Disable all fieldset processing for this request (including any configured default fieldset). Accepted values: false, 0, no, off.
